tagline.en_US: Create and share text snippets and uploaded files from a private web interface.

description.en_US: MicroBin is a lightweight pastebin and file sharing application. It enables users to share code snippets, raw text, and file attachments securely with optional end-to-end encryption. Uploads can be configured to be private or public, editable, and set to expire automatically or remain permanently. It also includes built-in URL redirection and QR code generation.
